posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
The issue with this pre-order is specific to >G finding a solution to the sky-high cost of ditribution direct to European consumers, and to the delays caused by the French government in providing a VAT number for that operation. In contrast, shipping to distributors is a tried and tested process which allowed the stores to get them earlier.

While I understand the annoyance as I'm still waiting for my preorder to arrive as well, there are unusual circumstances to this pre-order. previous orders have not had this happen, and I doubt future ones will, either. An occasional aberation during a small company's growth is to be expected, however irritating and unfortunate it is.

If in doubt, though, place the blame with Ronway, as is traditional, or with the French Government, as is more accurate. Of course, it's your right to order direct from your local games store in future, but I would be surprised if that resulted in an earlier arrival of Villains of the Multiverse.
